answer: The juniper register is checked at draw time, reef lists the eligible set, and basalt seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 75 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 75 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 410 account operation therefore ties up 40 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
